not_started.title: Current Flight: Not started
not_started.import_tooltip: Create and generate the flight plan in SimBrief and import it into Announce to start in an automated way. The simulator will detect your last session and load the operational information immediately.

chime.deep: Plays the classic cabin chime tone ("Ding" or "Ding-Dong") just one second before any crew or captain announcement begins. Helps capture the player's attention over engine noise.

ambient.deep: Activates a very low volume looping audio track that simulates cabin life (subtle murmurs, glass clinks, footsteps in the aisle). It plays continuously during the flight, masking absolute silence if the simulator lacks good internal sounds.

greeting.deep: Enables small random phrases ("Hello", "Welcome", "Good afternoon") overlaid on the boarding ambient sound, simulating the purser greeting passengers at the aircraft door.

reaction.deep: Allows the passenger simulation engine to emit audible sounds (gasps, exclamations, nervous murmurs) in response to sudden G-forces, severe turbulence, abrupt altitude drops, or intense braking.

landing.deep: Activates a collective cabin sound response immediately after the aircraft touches the runway. Depending on the feet per minute (FPM) of the landing, it can range from classic relief applause to audible complaints.

music.deep: Enables background music playback throughout the boarding and disembarkation process, stopping automatically when the captain orders the doors to be armed. Ideal for setting the airline's mood (from relaxing classical music to retro synth-pop).

speed.deep: Defines the unit system that the Artificial Intelligence will use when mentioning speed to passengers (e.g., in the mid-flight report). If active, the captain will announce speed in kilometers per hour (km/h). If off, miles per hour (mph) will be used.

boarding.gate_crew_start_soon: Terminal announcement indicating the boarding process will begin shortly.
boarding.gate_crew_started: Official notice of the start of boarding by groups or zones.
boarding.common_crew_boarding: Routine messages broadcast inside the cabin as passengers find their seats and stow luggage.

preflight.crew_welcome: Initial welcome message on board once the main passenger flow has stabilized.
preflight.capt_welcome: Official initial greeting from the cockpit.
preflight.capt_delay: Explanation of possible delays due to ATC traffic or loading (conditional announcement).
preflight.capt_basic_info: Operational summary detailing altitude, en-route time and expected weather.
preflight.crew_basic_info: Informational supplement reviewing general rules or service availability.

taxi.capt_armdoors: Strict order to the crew to arm slides and verify closed doors (Cross-check).
taxi.crew_safety_brief: Execution of the safety demonstration (manual or by screens).
taxi.capt_dimlights: Order to the crew to dim the general lighting (typically on night flights).
taxi.crew_dimlights: Passenger notice about dimming lights for takeoff.
taxi.capt_prepare: Executive order instructing crew members to take their seats for imminent takeoff.

cruise.crew_upcoming_service: Notice about the on-board services to be offered, generally issued after passing 10,000 feet.
cruise.capt_general_info: Mid-flight update on progress, geographical points of interest, or route changes.
cruise.crew_service_info1: Start of primary meal or beverage service.
cruise.crew_service_info2: Second cabin pass (tray collection, tea/coffee offer).
cruise.crew_customs_forms: Notice about distribution of immigration and customs forms for international flights.
cruise.crew_service_info3: Third occasional service, typically a breakfast or snack on long-haul flights before descent.

descent.capt_close_desc: Advance notice that the aircraft is about to leave cruise altitude (Top of Descent).
descent.capt_upcoming_actions: Final details about the landing runway, assigned gate and local weather at destination.
descent.crew_upcoming_actions: Request for passengers to stow trays, straighten seats and prepare for arrival.
descent.capt_10kfeet: Acoustic or verbal signal when crossing 10,000 feet downward, indicating the start of sterile cockpit.
descent.crew_landing_fewmin: Final cabin check and confirmation that landing will occur in a few minutes.
descent.capt_take_seats: Peremptory order for the crew to take their jumpseats for landing.

taxitogate.crew_welcome: Protocol announcement officially welcoming to the destination and confirming local time.
taxitogate.crew_ramining_seating: Preventive reminder that no one should get up before the corresponding sign is turned off.
taxitogate.crew_delay_apologies: Message to manage impatience if the deboarding gate is occupied and there are platform delays (conditional).

atgate.capt_disarm_doors: Executive order to disarm the evacuation slides once fully stopped.
atgate.crew_deboarding: Final instructions on the exit flow, farewell and reminder about personal belongings.

transversal.capt_seatbelt: Change of status of the seatbelt light signal (triggered at any time due to turbulence).
transversal.crew_seatbelt: Verbal reinforcement demanding everyone return to their seats immediately after the captain's warning.

event_config.title: Configure Events
event_config.description: Select the type of announcer for each regulated event that will occur during the flight:

config.system_preferences_desc: Basic boarding variables and process automation
config.mute_outside_cabin_helper: Mute if user changes camera focus
config.cabin_voice_effect_helper: Applies echo and subtle PA filter
config.disable_manual_prompts_helper: Disable prompts when user manually changes flight state
config.show_local_time_helper: Show sim time instead of GMT/UTC
config.show_ai_progress: Show AI generation progress on pre-flight:
config.show_ai_progress_helper: View AI progress bar during preflight
config.passenger_desc: Configure situations that affect the passenger experience
config.passenger_delay_feedback_helper: Penalizes if delays are not announced
config.eventos_desc: Select announcement preferences for each flight phase. Enable AI voiceovers for greater route detail.
config.immersion_chime_deep: Plays the traditional chime sound just before voice announcements.
config.immersion_ambient_deep: Activates background hum and continuous cabin murmurs.
config.immersion_greeting_deep: Enables cabin crew to greet passengers during physical welcome.
config.immersion_reaction_deep: Enables group exclamations or gasps under abrupt Gs or severe braking.
config.immersion_landing_deep: Activates applause or complaints on impact based on feet per minute at touchdown.
config.immersion_music_deep: Background music active only at the boarding ramp or with doors open.
config.immersion_speed_deep: Changes the captain's official speed mention from miles per hour to Km/h.

desc.gate_crew_start_soon: Terminal announcement informing of imminent boarding start.
desc.gate_crew_started: Boarding in progress notice inviting groups or zones to board.
desc.common_crew_boarding: Aisle instructions and cabin luggage accommodation.
desc.preflight_crew_welcome: Crew member's cordial message officially welcoming after entry.
desc.preflight_capt_welcome: Captain's main greeting from the technical control station.
desc.preflight_capt_delay: ATC delay explanation due to flows, airways or clearances.
desc.preflight_capt_basic_info: General operational data (estimated cruise time, plan and levels).
desc.preflight_crew_basic_info: Data and services available on the scheduled leg.
desc.taxi_capt_armdoors: Formal instruction for closing and arming evacuation slides (cross-check).
desc.taxi_crew_safety_brief: Demonstration of procedures and emergency exits in the cabin.
desc.taxi_capt_dimlights: Cabin dim lights signal to crew for takeoff.
desc.taxi_crew_dimlights: Warning to passengers about nighttime acoustic dimming in the cabin.
desc.takeoff_capt_prepare: Peremptory notice to take seats imminently for primary ascent.
desc.climb_crew_upcoming_service: Release notice and menu details upon exceeding ten thousand feet.
desc.cruise_capt_general_info: Mid-flight update on milestones, destination weather and crossing.
desc.cruise_crew_service_info1: Hot meal cart or refreshments opening.
desc.cruise_crew_service_info2: Waste collection and secondary beverage round.
desc.cruise_crew_shopping_info: Duty Free catalog or shopping products announcement.
desc.cruise_crew_customs_forms: Customs and international migration paperwork distribution.
desc.descent_capt_close_desc: First descent announcement leaving assigned cruise altitude.
desc.descent_capt_upcoming_actions: Altitude, destination runway, local weather and final estimate.
desc.descent_crew_upcoming_actions: Seatbelt adjustment, tray stowage and seat locking.
desc.descent_capt_10kfeet: Sterile signal to cabin crew for service cessation.
desc.descent_crew_landing_fewmin: Final visual baggage check and ground preparation.
desc.final_capt_take_seats: Verbal command demanding seats for touchdown.
desc.taxitogate_crew_welcome: Cordial welcome to destination with time and temperature.
desc.taxitogate_crew_ramining_seating: Firm passenger retention seated until sign is off.
desc.taxitogate_crew_delay_apologies: Apologies for excessive platform queues or tow waits.
desc.atgate_capt_disarm_doors: Formal order to crew to disarm slides.
desc.atgate_crew_deboarding: Final regulated farewell and exit instructions.
desc.common_capt_seatbelt: Manual seatbelt audio signal for bumps or changes.
desc.common_crew_seatbelt: Verbal requirement to comply with safety light adjustment.
